1	// andesim command-line parsing.
2	//
3	// The grammar is deliberately tiny and stable across all subcommands:
4	//
5	//   andesim [<cmd>] [--mode M] [--engine E] [--trigger T] [positional...]
6	//                   [-- <verbatim engine args...>]
7	//
8	// `run` is the default command: when the first token is not a known
9	// subcommand (and not a top-level help flag), the whole line parses as
10	// `run ...`, so `andesim --mode fast prog.elf` works without typing `run`.
11	//
12	// The single most important rule is the `--` boundary: every token after the
13	// first `--` is captured verbatim into `passthrough` and is NOT interpreted by
14	// the framework. That is what lets `fast`/`cycle` forward an engine's whole
15	// native CLI (e.g. `-gdb tcp::1234 -S`) untouched, so users see one simulator.
16	#ifndef ANDESIM_CLI_HPP
17	#define ANDESIM_CLI_HPP
18	
19	#include <string>
20	#include <string_view>
21	#include <vector>
22	
23	namespace andes_sim {
24	
25	// True for the known command names (run/list/doctor/profile). The single
26	// source of truth shared by the parser (default-command rule) and main's
27	// dispatch.
28	bool is_subcommand(std::string_view name);
29	
30	struct Cli {
31	  std::string subcommand;                 // e.g. "run", "list"; "" if none
32	  std::string model;                      // --mode fast|cycle|hybrid (field stays 'model': the concept, see list models)
33	  std::string engine;                     // --engine <id>
34	  std::string trigger;                    // --trigger marker|pc
35	  // Hybrid trigger args (empty => cmd_run applies the default). pc boundaries
36	  // are a symbol name or 0x address; the sizes stay strings here and are
37	  // parsed where they are used.
38	  std::string pc_start;                   // --pc-start (trigger pc)
39	  std::string pc_end;                     // --pc-end   (trigger pc)
40	  std::string mem_size;                   // --mem-size (guest memory; --mmap-size is a hidden alias)
41	  std::string runtime;                    // --runtime linux (proxy-kernel payload; "" => bare-metal ELF, the default)
42	  std::string kanata;                     // --kanata <file> (marker/pc ROI trace)
43	  std::string objdump;                    // --objdump <file> (kanata labels)
44	  std::string log_level;                  // --log-level 0..6 (vsim scale; "" => info)
45	  std::string log_file;                   // --log-file <path> (full trace capture)
46	  std::string step_timeout_ms;            // --step-timeout-ms (hybrid per-leg spawn timeout; "" => PlanOptions' 90000)
47	  std::vector<std::string> positional;    // non-flag framework args
48	  std::vector<std::string> passthrough;   // verbatim, everything after `--`
49	  bool help = false;                      // -h / --help (before `--`)
50	  bool dry_run = false;                   // --dry-run (build, run, test, ...)
51	  bool print_memmap = false;              // --print-memmap (run --mode hybrid)
52	  bool verify = false;                    // --verify (run --mode hybrid)
53	  bool gdb = false;                       // --gdb (fast: QEMU gdbstub; cycle: vsim JTAG + ICEman)
54	  std::string gdb_port;                   // --gdb-port (fast: default 1234; cycle: default 9104)
55	  // profile's report knobs (values stay strings; cmd_profile applies the
56	  // defaults where they are used, like mem_size/gdb_port above).
57	  std::string limit;                      // --limit (profile; "" => 50)
58	  std::string min_iters;                  // --min-iters (profile; "" => 1)
59	  std::string addr2line;                  // --addr2line (profile; "" => auto)
60	  bool raw = false;                       // --raw (profile: dump the plugin log)
61	  bool llm = true;                        // --llm / --no-llm (profile report format)
62	  bool optimize_rvv = true;               // --optimize-rvv / --no-optimize-rvv (profile)
63	  bool no_source = false;                 // --no-source (profile: skip addr2line)
64	  bool has_passthrough = false;           // a `--` boundary was present
65	  std::string error;                      // non-empty => parse failed
66	};
67	
68	// Parse argv[1..] (program name skipped). The vector overload is the testable
69	// core; the argv overload adapts it for main().
70	Cli parse_cli(const std::vector<std::string>& args);
71	Cli parse_cli(int argc, char** argv);
72	
73	}  // namespace andes_sim
74	
75	#endif  // ANDESIM_CLI_HPP
76

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Release-surface contract: the andesim PRODUCT help shows only the finished,
3	# user-facing commands (run, profile, list, doctor) and never the third-party
4	# simulator name "verilator". The former developer commands build/test/state-diff
5	# have moved OUT of the binary (build -> scripts/build_all.sh, test ->
6	# scripts/test_all.sh, state-diff -> the diff_states core behind `run --verify`):
7	# they are not listed in any help and are not dispatchable. The removed /
8	# never-shipped commands (cluster, archive, replay, estimate) must
9	# not be advertised in any help. The cycle-accurate engine is presented as "vsim" everywhere --
10	# proven end to end with a fake engine that self-describes as "verilator" and
11	# must come back out as vsim:.
12	set -uo pipefail
13	
14	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
15	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
16	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
17	
18	BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
19	
20	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
21	
22	# has RE TEXT  -- TEXT must match RE ; missing RE TEXT -- TEXT must NOT match RE
23	has()     { printf '%s\n' "$2" | grep -Eq "$1"; }
24	no_word() { ! printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -qi 'verilator'; }
25	
26	# 1. release --help: a clear command TREE -- run/list/doctor are the major
27	# commands (column 0); each is followed by its indented subcommands (run's
28	# modes, list's targets); run carries its full option list with REQUIRED flags
29	# marked. No developer-commands section, no "verilator", no dev-only fixtures.
30	H=$("$BIN" --help 2>&1)
31	has '^run '     "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'run':"$'\n'"$H"
32	has '^profile ' "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'profile':"$'\n'"$H"
33	has '^list '    "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'list':"$'\n'"$H"
34	has '^doctor '  "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'doctor':"$'\n'"$H"
35	for s in fast cycle hybrid; do
36	  has "^  $s " "$H" || fail "release --help: run missing subcommand '$s':"$'\n'"$H"
37	done
38	for t in models engines; do
39	  has "^  $t " "$H" || fail "release --help: list missing target '$t':"$'\n'"$H"
40	done
41	has 'REQUIRED for hybrid' "$H" || fail "release --help: --trigger not marked REQUIRED for hybrid:"$'\n'"$H"
42	for c in build test state-diff cluster archive replay estimate; do
43	  has "(^|  )$c " "$H" && fail "release --help: leaked non-release command '$c'"
44	done
45	no_word "$H" || fail "release --help: leaked 'verilator'"
46	has 'developer command' "$H" && fail "release --help: developer commands moved to scripts/; drop the section:"$'\n'"$H"
47	has '^  fixtures ' "$H" && fail "release --help: leaked dev-only 'fixtures' target:"$'\n'"$H"
48	ok "release --help: run/list/doctor tree with subcommands + REQUIRED flags, no dev/removed surface"
49	
50	# 2. The developer commands left the binary entirely: ANDESIM_DEV=1 --help adds
51	# NO commands (run/list/doctor only) -- it only reveals the dev 'fixtures'
52	# target. build/test/state-diff are not dispatchable.
53	D=$(ANDESIM_DEV=1 "$BIN" --help 2>&1)
54	for c in run profile list doctor; do
55	  has "^$c " "$D" || fail "dev --help: missing major command '$c':"$'\n'"$D"
56	done
57	for c in build test state-diff cluster archive replay estimate; do
58	  has "(^|  )$c " "$D" && fail "dev --help: leaked removed/hidden command '$c'"
59	done
60	has '^  fixtures ' "$D" || fail "dev --help: should reveal the dev 'fixtures' target:"$'\n'"$D"
61	no_word "$D" || fail "dev --help: leaked 'verilator'"
62	# Not dispatchable as commands: since the default-command rule (run may be
63	# omitted), an unknown first word parses as `run`'s own argument and fails
64	# run's validation -- it must NOT reach any build/test/state-diff behavior.
65	for c in build test state-diff; do
66	  expect 2 "run: --mode fast.cycle.hybrid is required" "$BIN" "$c"
67	done
68	ok "dev --help: dev 'fixtures' target revealed, no developer commands; build/test/state-diff parse as run args and fail (rc 2)"
69	
70	# 3. run --help: the --engine example reads vsim:, never verilator:; the
71	# --trigger menu offers only the supported triggers (marker|pc).
72	RH=$("$BIN" run --help 2>&1)
73	has 'vsim:' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing vsim: example"
74	no_word "$RH" || fail "run --help: leaked 'verilator'"
75	has ' --mem-size' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --mem-size:"$'\n'"$RH"
76	has ' --mmap-size' "$RH" && fail "run --help: retired --mmap-size alias should stay hidden:"$'\n'"$RH"
77	# Interactive-debug + oracle knobs are user-facing: documented in the release help.
78	has '^  --verify '   "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --verify:"$'\n'"$RH"
79	has '^  --print-memmap ' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --print-memmap:"$'\n'"$RH"
80	has '^  --gdb '      "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --gdb:"$'\n'"$RH"
81	has '^  --gdb-port ' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --gdb-port:"$'\n'"$RH"
82	# The ROI pipeline-trace knobs are user-facing: --kanata, with --objdump
83	# nested under it (it requires --kanata, like the pc pair under --trigger).
84	has '^  --kanata '    "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --kanata:"$'\n'"$RH"
85	has '^    --objdump ' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --objdump nested under --kanata:"$'\n'"$RH"
86	# run --help is sliced from the same tree: it shows the mode subcommands and
87	# marks the required flags (so a user sees --trigger is mandatory for hybrid).
88	has '^  fast '   "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing mode subcommand 'fast':"$'\n'"$RH"
89	has '^  hybrid ' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing mode subcommand 'hybrid':"$'\n'"$RH"
90	has '^  --trigger ' "$RH" || fail "run --help: missing --trigger:"$'\n'"$RH"
91	has 'REQUIRED for hybrid' "$RH" || fail "run --help: --trigger not marked REQUIRED for hybrid:"$'\n'"$RH"
92	ok "run --help: vsim: example, modes + REQUIRED markers, no verilator, --mem-size/--verify/--gdb documented"
93	
94	# 4. list models: composition cells read vsim (never verilator), and NOTES show
95	# user-facing model traits only -- no implementation detail.
96	LM=$("$BIN" list models 2>&1)
97	has 'vsim' "$LM" || fail "list models: missing vsim"
98	no_word "$LM" || fail "list models: leaked 'verilator'"
99	for d in 'transparent passthrough' 'pure from reset'; do
100	  has "$d" "$LM" && fail "list models: leaked implementation detail '$d':"$'\n'"$LM"
101	done
102	ok "list models: vsim, no verilator, no implementation detail"
103	
104	# 5. list engines end to end: a fake engine that self-describes as "verilator"
105	# must surface as vsim: (the single normalization point), proving --engine /
106	# errors / list all speak the product name with no real sim_* needed.
107	TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
108	cat >"$TMP/sim_fake" <<'EOF'
109	#!/bin/sh
110	[ "$1" = "--describe" ] && printf '%s\n' '{"id":"verilator:fakecfg","type":"verilator","kind":"cycle-accurate","vlen":256,"xlen":64,"triggers":["marker","pc"],"roles":["standalone","accurate-leg"],"state":["resume","drain"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]},"result":"stderr:cycles"}'
111	EOF
